title: Alien autopsy document and the other Edgar Mitchell papers

tellings.quote: And then he sent me the alien autopsy document and that had Kit Green

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that a man named James Rigney sent him a set of papers tied to the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell, among them an "alien autopsy document" that had the name of a man called Kit Green on it. Cameron tells this as someone who received the papers himself, and says they also included a condolence letter connected to Charles Lindbergh and a record of meetings of NIDS, a private UFO research group. If real, the papers would tie a moon astronaut's circle to talk of examining an alien body.
